observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation console with the front seam visible; no cables/accessories shown.
Photo 1 shows the top/front face with the PlayStation logo; no model label/serial number visible.
Photo 2 shows the rear/side view with multiple ports/vents visible, but no readable port labels or serial/model text.

claims.claim: PS4 Pro packs in twice the GPU power of the standard PS4 – letting you experience incredible image...
claims.evidence: No technical specs or model identification visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show internal condition, repair history, temperatures, or port testing.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No original pads/accessories or UK receipt are shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (could be a different PS4 variant); price depends heavily on whether it’s actually PS4 Pro.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label/serial/model text (sticker on the back/bottom) and/or the exact model number shown in Settings → System → System Information.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-likelihood case among PS4 variants (worst case: not PS4 Pro).

risks.risk: Port issues or intermittent faults (seller says all ports work, but no testing evidence).
risks.proof: Short video showing each port being used (HDMI, USB, power) with the console powered on and a game/menu displayed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully confirmed working (worst case: ports may be faulty).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal problems or prior repair (seller says never opened/repaired and no overheating).
risks.proof: Video of a 20–30 minute gameplay/session with the console running, plus a screenshot/photo of system temperature/health if available (or at least no shutdowns).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially overheating/needs service (worst case: may require repair).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/receipt/pads (seller claims originals and UK receipt, but not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of the included items laid out (pads/accessories) and a clear photo of the UK receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only (worst case: no receipt/accessories).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console’s sticker label showing model/serial number (back or bottom).
Video showing the console booting and working (menu + one game) and demonstrating HDMI + USB ports.
Photo/video of included accessories (“original pads”) and the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos show a PlayStation console but do not provide readable model/serial information to confirm it is PS4 Pro, and the seller’s condition/accessory claims are not evidenced. Without model confirmation and working/port proof, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
